title: {enemy:bruiser}
text:
一把{item:warhammer}，{item_stat:warhammer:seconds} 秒一下，一下 {item_stat:warhammer:damage} 点。血不多。

{item:plate_cuirass}的护甲能接住它头两三锤，趁这段时间把它放倒；{item:tower_shield}减的那 {item_stat:tower_shield:block} 点在它面前不算什么。

texts.en:
One {item:warhammer}: a blow every {item_stat:warhammer:seconds} seconds, {item_stat:warhammer:damage} damage a blow. Not much Health.

The Armor on the {item:plate_cuirass} can take its first two or three blows. Put it down while that lasts. The {item_stat:tower_shield:block} the {item:tower_shield} shaves off each hit means nothing against it.
